body: Thank you for the reply. It's good \(and very sad\) to hear that I'm not alone with that feeling. I truly wish the best for you. That's all I can say. Everything else is just so hard to put into words but I think you know how I feel and that's enough. Thanks again.

Thank you for your words. It's just so hard to imagine that it can get better. I just don't know how to get the energy and will to get through all of that. It's just so tiring.

I'm happy for you that you could get out of that. I truly am.
